countedBy: lane #199 (opus) from the rectified panorama crops w04-72 (TMX7316010203-002591_pano_0000_000992, 2022-06-13, 50 px/m), w02-162 (recording_2025-06-19_03-28-47_03197, 50 px/m) and w01-342 (b_20241211_0954_Track03_Sphere_00013 and its 2021 second view, 37.8 px/m); ribbon convention; a door and a shop window count. Not a blind haiku count; the integrator may re-count.

facades.name: tower east face (Rhijnspoorplein)
facades.note: The 14.8 m BAG wall from the tower's south corner to the drum: four bays of wide four-light windows, a two-storey ground floor of four tall windows (1.1-6.7 m) and eight storeys of four windows inside the crop (the crop ends at 32 m; the ninth storey and the two bays over the drum are outside it).

facades.name: tower south face (garden)
facades.note: The tower's 15.2 m garden face: a column of window pairs at each end (four windows, four axes per storey), the glazed strip in the middle running from the ground through the whole crop (one opening; its centre, about 16 m, falls between the storey bands, so it is its own band), two tall ground-storey windows centred under the pair columns (two more axes): seven axes.

facades.name: brick front on the Sarphatistraat
facades.note: The 39.3 m BAG wall from the drum to the party wall (the drum is cropped off the left). Bottom up: three shop fronts, the door and the glazed ground floor of the west part; the two tall window pairs by the drum (centre about 4.3 m); storey 1 (seven pair axes and a single window in the east part, three pairs in the west part); storey 2 (east pairs and single, the west part's tall pairs); the short storey-3 windows of the east part; the west part's top storey, cut at 16 m by the crop.
